name: Jar wine
summary: Êđê wine of sticky rice and a yeast of galangal pounded with forest leaves, rested in the jar for months. It pours cloudy white, sweet, and fragrant.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 30 Mar 2019 says Buon Ma Thuot Êđê wine has its own taste, even though the city is not the jar-wine capital.
howToEat: Everyone drinks from the same jar, pulling through long straws together. It is ready after more than three months and better at a year.
where: Ako Dhong, where the jars are still made, and with the meal at Ko Tam or Buon Tri A.
seoTitle: Ruou can in Buon Ma Thuot — Ede jar wine in Ako Dhong
seoDescription: Ede jar wine from sticky rice and leaf yeast, cloudy white, sweet, and fragrant, shared through straws in Ako Dhong.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 30 Mar 2019 calls a finished jar cloudy white, sweet, fragrant, and refreshing, and says a long rest makes it deeper.
